_comment: LINEAGE corpus ingest — the AI Studio and NotebookLM layers of lineage.db.
The Gemini web-app layer is written into the SAME file by tools/StoryPlanner.GeminiCorpus
(point its <output.db> argument at the output below); each ingest replaces only its own tables.
aistudio population rule (2026-08-18): the never-imported founding-era set. A raw chat is
included unless <name>.json exists in the excludeImportedVia subfolder (those 34 were imported
into the .storyplan Conversations corpus and are tracked there) or its name is in exclude.
The dry run names every inclusion/exclusion so near-miss filenames are caught by eye —
exclude is the authored escape hatch for pairs the mechanical rule cannot see.
notebooklm: captures are manual saves (Ctrl+S, complete webpage, chat panel scrolled fully
to the TOP — history is server-side lazy-loaded and an under-scrolled save silently loses
older turns). slug and authoredDate are AUTHORED — chat turns carry no timestamps in a
capture, so the date is the author's assignment (year or year-month precision is fine),
never derived from content. Undated notebooks stay undated and are flagged on every run.
